title: Production REST APIs with FastAPI & Pydantic
objective: Build and document high-performance, asynchronous RESTful APIs with automated OpenAPI schemas and request validation.
practice_tasks: Implement a CRUD API for a bookstore with input validation using Pydantic v2.
Integrate JWT authentication middleware with role-based access control (Admin vs User).
Write async test suites using httpx and pytest-asyncio with >85% code coverage.
artifacts: A containerized, self-documenting FastAPI microservice with PostgreSQL database migrations (Alembic) and GitHub Actions CI workflow.

title: Modern Pythonic Programming & Type Annotations
objective: Master idiomatic Python 3.11+ features, generator pipelines, type hinting, and OOP patterns for production systems.
practice_tasks: Build a custom file parser using generators and context managers to stream large log files without memory exhaustion.
Create reusable function decorators for caching, latency timing, and exponential backoff retry.
Refactor a legacy script into a clean, typed package passing strict mypy checks.
artifacts: A standalone CLI utility published with pyproject.toml, full unit test suite, and semantic versioning.

title: Advanced PostgreSQL & Relational Database Engineering
objective: Design normalized relational schemas, write high-performance indexed queries, and manage transaction isolation.
practice_tasks: Design an e-commerce schema with inventory, orders, and payment audit tables using foreign keys and check constraints.
Optimize an unindexed slow join query using EXPLAIN ANALYZE, reducing query execution time by 80%.
Write transactional stored procedures ensuring inventory is atomically decremented during checkout.
artifacts: Production schema migration repository with schema diagrams (ERD) and benchmarked query performance reports.

title: Containerization with Docker & Multi-Stage Builds
objective: Containerize full-stack services with minimal image sizes, non-root users, and multi-service docker-compose orchestration.
practice_tasks: Write a multi-stage Dockerfile for a Next.js/FastAPI application reducing image size from 1GB to under 120MB.
Orchestrate a multi-container stack (API, PostgreSQL, Redis) with healthchecks and volume persistence in docker-compose.yml.
Configure container security scanning with Trivy and eliminate root user execution.
artifacts: A production-ready docker-compose application template with environment variable segregation and zero-vulnerability container images.

title: Enterprise RESTful Architecture & API Contract Design
objective: Design clean, scalable RESTful web APIs adhering to HTTP standards, semantic status codes, and hypermedia principles.
practice_tasks: Design an API contract using OpenAPI 3.0 YAML specifying schemas, request bodies, and error response codes.
Implement cursor-based pagination and parameter filtering for a high-volume activity stream endpoint.
Add standardized error handling returning machine-readable problem details (RFC 7807).
artifacts: A published OpenAPI interactive Swagger documentation specification alongside a mock server implementation.

title: Distributed In-Memory Caching & Messaging with Redis
objective: Accelerate server responses through caching strategies and implement rate limiters and pub/sub message brokers.
practice_tasks: Implement a sliding-window rate limiter in Python/Node using Redis Sorted Sets to restrict API client requests.
Set up a cache-aside layer over database query results with automatic cache invalidation on updates.
Build a live broadcast notification channel using Redis Pub/Sub.
artifacts: A benchmarked caching proxy demonstrating 10x throughput enhancement on high-cardinality database queries.

title: Collaborative Git, Rebasing & Trunk-Based Development
objective: Execute clean version control workflows, resolve complex merge conflicts, and manage branch releases professionally.
practice_tasks: Use interactive rebase (`git rebase -i`) to clean up a messy feature branch into 3 atomic, semantic commits.
Locate the exact commit introducing a regression in a sample repository using automated `git bisect run`.
Simulate and resolve conflicting upstream changes between two active feature branches.
artifacts: A well-structured GitHub repository exhibiting conventional commits, automated PR validation workflows, and release tags.

title: Automated Testing, Mocking & Test-Driven Development (TDD)
objective: Build comprehensive test suites using fixtures, dependency mocks, and regression safety mechanisms.
topics: Unit vs Integration vs E2E Tests
practice_tasks: Write unit tests for a financial calculation engine using parameterized test inputs covering edge cases.
Mock an external third-party payment gateway API in integration tests without making live network calls.
Achieve >90% branch coverage on a service module verified by automated CI coverage gates.
artifacts: A fully tested Python service module accompanied by coverage badges, mutation test reports, and automated CI tests.

title: Deep Learning Architecture Engineering with PyTorch
objective: Design, train, and evaluate deep neural networks, custom loss functions, and data loaders using PyTorch.
practice_tasks: Construct a convolutional neural network (CNN) or Transformer encoder from scratch using torch.nn modules.
Fine-tune a pretrained Vision or Language model on a specialized custom dataset with validation early stopping.
Profile GPU memory allocation and implement mixed-precision training (`torch.cuda.amp`).
artifacts: A trained PyTorch model weights artifact along with training/validation loss curves and evaluation classification reports.

title: MLOps, Experiment Tracking & Model Serving
objective: Automate machine learning experiment tracking, model registry management, and production inference deployment.
practice_tasks: Track hyperparameters, training metrics, and model artifacts across 5 training runs with MLflow.
Package a PyTorch model into a Dockerized inference microservice with Prometheus latency metrics.
Simulate incoming inference distribution shifts and detect feature drift using Evidently AI / statistical tests.
artifacts: An automated MLOps pipeline repository linking Git commits to model versions, registry promotions, and live inference endpoints.

title: Foundational Machine Learning & Statistical Learning

Perform cross-validated hyperparameter search using Optuna on XGBoost to maximize F1-score on imbalanced data.
Compute and analyze confusion matrices, ROC-AUC curves, and feature importance SHAP values.

title: Data Wrangling & Exploratory Analysis with Pandas

practice_tasks: Clean a raw, messy 500,000-row transactional dataset resolving missing values, incorrect dtypes, and duplicates.
Compute rolling metrics, cohort retention rates, and multi-level group summaries.
Optimize dataframe memory footprint by converting object columns to categorical and downcasting integer types.
artifacts: An exploratory data analysis (EDA) report with reproducible data transformation pipelines and summary metrics.

Implement a 2D convolution kernel filter from scratch using array slicing and broadcasting.
Benchmark vectorized array operations against native Python loops demonstrating 50x-100x speedups.

Create a custom transformer that calculates domain-specific financial ratios during cross-validation folds.
Save and validate a trained pipeline artifact with joblib, verifying deterministic prediction output.
artifacts: A packaged, reproducible scikit-learn pipeline module ready for deployment into microservice inference endpoints.

title: Statistical Foundations for Data Science & A/B Testing

p-values, Type I / Type II Errors, Statistical Power

Determine required sample size for 80% statistical power at alpha = 0.05 given an expected minimum detectable effect (MDE).
Conduct a Chi-Square test of independence on categorical user survey responses.
artifacts: An executive A/B test decision-support memorandum complete with power analysis, distribution plots, and risk bounds.
